office_does: A Grant County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all three judges are elected countywide to four-year terms.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Nicholas L Wallace, on the bench since 2021, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Grant County District Court judge since 2021 and presiding judge, after 25 years as a trial lawyer and managing partner at Schultheis Tabler Wallace; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since 2021 and presiding judge; Superior Court judge pro tem since 2022 [S1]
Says the court has expanded remote hearings and helped establish a therapeutic court [S1]
